name: Yukiko
source:
The quintessence of maid's game machine is here!

The latest consumer doll released by Ninkendo Co.
YUU" is a coined word. The etymology of the word "YUU" is "You," "Yu," "You," and "The letter U represents the smile of a family.
The concept is "We take care of your family's health! the YUU is designed not only to be a game console, but also to provide a full range of functions to help with cooking, cleaning, laundry, and other tasks.
Of course, YUU is just as professional as a professional in taking care of health, including nutritional management and house dust control, and many households even let her manage the household finances.
These features have been a big hit for YUU.
Rival machine Presta 7 is on the offensive, but it seems unlikely that it will be able to keep up with the competition.


[From Pikopiko's official website]
